# Anthropic Dart Client

> Dart client for the Anthropic API to build with Claude — messages, streaming, tool calling, extended thinking, multimodal prompts, files, skills, and batches.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/README.md) (~16.6k tokens): Primary package documentation with installation, configuration, and usage examples.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/CHANGELOG.md) (~12.9k tokens): Release history and version-by-version changes.
- [MIGRATION](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/MIGRATION.md) (~15.9k tokens): Upgrade notes and breaking-change guidance.

## Examples

- [workload_identity_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/workload_identity_example.dart) (~375 tokens): Exchange a workload identity JWT and call Messages.
- [federation_issuers_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/federation_issuers_example.dart) (~247 tokens): List OIDC issuers with an organization OAuth token.
- [federation_rules_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/federation_rules_example.dart) (~217 tokens): List federation rules and workspace bindings.
- [messages_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/messages_example.dart) (~794 tokens): Basic message creation.
- [streaming_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/streaming_example.dart) (~1.3k tokens): Streaming responses.
- [structured_output_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/structured_output_example.dart) (~341 tokens): Typed JSON output with buffered or streamed responses.
- [tool_calling_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/tool_calling_example.dart) (~685 tokens): Tool calling with schemas.
- [inline_tools_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/inline_tools_example.dart) (~302 tokens): Define a client tool partway through a conversation (beta).
- [browser_use_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/browser_use_example.dart) (~1k tokens): Browser-use toolset with `browser_state` tool results.
- [computer_use_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/computer_use_example.dart) (~897 tokens): Computer-use toolset (`computer_toolset_20260801`).
- [message_tool_runner_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/message_tool_runner_example.dart) (~381 tokens): Bounded typed custom tool loop with optional streaming and threads.
- [mcp_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/mcp_example.dart) (~537 tokens): Connect an MCP server and pin its tool listing (beta).
- [web_fetch_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/web_fetch_example.dart) (~300 tokens): Restrict URL sources and inspect web fetch results.
- [thinking_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/thinking_example.dart) (~2.2k tokens): Adaptive thinking, progress updates, block binding, and multi-turn replay.
- [message_threads_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/message_threads_example.dart) (~276 tokens): Create and continue a Messages thread (beta).
- [message_thread_helper_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/message_thread_helper_example.dart) (~210 tokens): Track a thread and opt into bounded recovery (beta).
- [context_management_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/context_management_example.dart) (~293 tokens): Edit context and preview input token counts (beta).
- [on_demand_compaction_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/on_demand_compaction_example.dart) (~366 tokens): Stream a signed summary and replay it (beta).
- [vision_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/vision_example.dart) (~1.2k tokens): Image and document inputs.
- [custom_content_document_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/custom_content_document_example.dart) (~300 tokens): Cite custom document chunks by block index.
- [token_counting_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/token_counting_example.dart) (~1k tokens): Token counting.
- [message_batches_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/message_batches_example.dart) (~874 tokens): Batch processing.
- [models_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/models_example.dart) (~309 tokens): Model lifecycle filters, pagination, and capabilities.

- [bedrock_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/bedrock_example.dart) (~346 tokens): Stream Claude through Bedrock Mantle or Runtime.
- [google_cloud_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/google_cloud_example.dart) (~384 tokens): Send a message through Anthropic-managed Google Cloud or Vertex.
- [foundry_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/foundry_example.dart) (~284 tokens): Stream a Foundry deployment with Azure authentication.

- [environments_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/anthropic_sdk_dart/example/environments_example.dart) (~206 tokens): Managed Agents cloud and self-hosted environment lifecycle (beta).
